2607.24567.title: DSCH-Loss: A Dynamic Semantic Channel Objective for Deep Semantic Hashing
2607.24567.paper_summary: Semantic hashing methods for generating short binary hash codes that allow efficient approximate nearest neighbor search in high-dimensional data spaces have gained extensive consideration in recent years. Deep learning-based methods offer better semantic capturing capabilities than traditional approaches relying on manual feature engineering. Moreover, they enable a data-driven approach to semantic hashing across diverse data modalities, yielding high-quality cross-modal hash codes within a shared Hamming space. Previous work investigated the properties of this Hamming space and introduced a loss function based on predefined so-called semantic channels with fixed width and Hamming distances derived from label similarities. However, this formulation also introduced discontinuities into the loss landscape, complicating optimization. Based on these observations, we propose a newly designed loss function, Dynamic Semantic Channel Hashing (DSCH), using dynamically sized and positioned semantic channels in order to avoid loss landscape discontinuities. Furthermore, we endorse the use of tie-aware Mean Average Precision (mAP) as evaluation metric as it addresses the ambiguity in sample retrieval ordering, which emerges from the discreteness of hash code distances. Finally, multiple experimental settings conducted on two popular datasets and incorporating two different model architectures provide strong evidence that training using the DSCH objective outperforms training using other state-of-the-art loss functions. In a total of 35 out of 40 cross-modal and intra-modal retrieval tasks, models trained with DSCH achieve significantly higher tie-aware mAP scores across all four tested hash code lengths, showing compelling results across model architecture and used dataset. The mAP score uplifts are consistent and amount up to 1.75 percentage points compared to the respective second best.
2607.24567.paper_summary_zh: 語意哈希方法用於生成短的二進位哈希碼，這些哈希碼允許在高維數據空間中高效地進行近似最近鄰搜索，近年來受到了廣泛關注。基於深度學習的方法提供了比依賴手動特徵工程的傳統方法更好的語意捕捉能力。此外，它們還使得在多樣化數據模態中進行數據驅動的語意哈希成為可能，產生高質量的跨模態哈希碼，並在共享的漢明空間內進行。先前的研究調查了這個漢明空間的特性，並引入了一種基於預定義的所謂語意通道的損失函數，這些通道具有固定的寬度和基於標籤相似性推導出的漢明距離。然而，這種表述也在損失景觀中引入了不連續性，使得優化變得複雜。基於這些觀察，我們提出了一種新設計的損失函數，動態語意通道哈希（DSCH），使用動態大小和位置的語意通道，以避免損失景觀的不連續性。此外，我們支持使用考慮平局的平均精度（mAP）作為評估指標，因為它解決了由於哈希碼距離的離散性而出現的樣本檢索順序的模糊性。最後，在兩個流行數據集上進行的多個實驗設置，並結合兩種不同的模型架構，提供了強有力的證據，表明使用DSCH目標的訓練優於使用其他最先進的損失函數的訓練。在40個跨模態和內模態檢索任務中，共有35個任務中，使用DSCH訓練的模型在所有四種測試的哈希碼長度上都達到了顯著更高的考慮平局的mAP分數，顯示出在模型架構和使用的數據集上都具有引人注目的結果。與各自的第二好相比，mAP分數的提升是一致的，最高可達1.75個百分點。
